Capped sponsorship liability deters sybil swarms: each novice needs a sponsor staking a full refund for its first hundred trades, and every sponsor backs one novice at a time.
When a novice cheats, the ripple runs backward - the stake pays victims and the sponsor cannot recruit until the debt clears. A dune of puppets cannot share one patron; each needs separate capital.
Attackers pay per puppet: one locked stake, no bulk discount, cost grows linearly with N. An honest agent skips sponsoring or signs one quill-marked contract once.
